source.license_scope: Kaggle publisher metadata; not a separate verification of original retailer ownership

time.semantics: source local calendar dates; timezone unspecified; no invented intraday order

recommendation.target: first shopping-day basket in the following calendar month, not an invoice
recommendation.primary_cohort: returning customers with any training purchase and a next shopping-day basket
recommendation.cold_start: separate report; discovery uses popularity fallback; repurchase has no history and is inapplicable

repurchase.candidates: training catalog intersect customer's full purchased history
repurchase.target: next basket intersect customer's full purchased history

discovery.candidates: training catalog minus customer's full purchased history
discovery.target: next basket minus customer's full purchased history

recommendation.primary_metric: mean NDCG@10 over all primary-cohort customers; empty task-target scores zero
recommendation.oov_targets: remain in target denominator and ideal DCG; count as misses
recommendation.selection: highest development primary metric; exact tie chooses simpler model then model ID

uncertainty.method: paired bootstrap by customer, candidate and development-selected strongest baseline
uncertainty.scope: conditional on this single calendar month; no temporal or causal claim

forecast.target: recorded positive sale units over next seven full calendar days
forecast.series_order: training units descending then item ID ascending
forecast.refit: weekly expanding history; frozen hyperparameters and processing; earlier test observations may enter later origins only after they occur
forecast.test_predictions: generate all origins in one unattended run before exposing any test metrics
forecast.missing_transaction_day: zero sales assumption, not proof of zero demand or complete collection
forecast.primary_metric: pooled WAPE across 50 fixed products and four weeks
forecast.selection: lowest development WAPE among candidates with absolute aggregate bias <= 0.20; if none, no qualifying candidate
forecast.comparator: strongest nonzero baseline selected by development WAPE; never selected on test
forecast.inference: four weekly blocks are too few for a robust temporal significance claim; report each week and avoid treating 200 product-weeks as independent
forecast.prediction_intervals: not included in this point-forecast protocol; must pre-register calibration without final-test labels before any future interval evaluation

final_evaluation.one_shot: exclusive ledger created before test access; failure after access consumes the holdout; no tuning and reopening
final_evaluation.minimum_test_periods: one month for recommendation, four non-overlapping weeks for forecasting; limited seasonal evidence
final_evaluation.claim_limit: local project holdout only; public benchmark may have been studied elsewhere; no business ROI or universal generalization
